# DevExpress Rich Edit Export Package

`DevExpress.RichEdit.Export` contains document export and print functionality for the rich text document model.

You do not need to install this package separately. It is installed as a common dependency with the following DevExpress products:

* [Office & PDF File API](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/office-file-api/) - Word Document API
* [WinForms Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/) - Rich Text Editor
* [WPF Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/wpf/) - Rich Text Editor
* [ASP.NET Core Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/aspnet-core/) - Rich Text Editor
* [ASP.NET WebForms Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/aspnet/) - Rich Text Editor
* [Blazor Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/blazor/) - Rich Text Editor
* [DevExpress Reports](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/reporting/) - Rich text content in report controls

## Evaluation Period, Pricing Options, and Licensing Terms

Whether you own a license or want to start a 30-day evaluation period, download and register your DevExpress license key. To obtain your key, log in to the [DevExpress Download Manager](https://www.devexpress.com/ClientCenter/DownloadManager/). Use your existing DevExpress.com account or create a new account for free. For key registration instructions, see [License Key for DevExpress Products]( https://www.devexpress.com/go/Licensing_Documentation.aspx).

If you purchase a license after evaluating a product, re-register your updated DevExpress license key to remove evaluation version warnings/messages. 

This package is included in the following commercial subscriptions:

* [DevExpress WinForms Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/)
* [DevExpress WPF Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/wpf/)
* [DevExpress ASP.NET Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/subscriptions/asp/)
* [DevExpress Reporting Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/subscriptions/reporting/)
* [DevExpress Office & PDF File API Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/office-file-api/)
* [DevExpress DXperience Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/subscriptions/dxperience.xml)
* [DevExpress Universal Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/subscriptions/universal.xml)

See [DevExpress Subscriptions & Licensing](https://www.devexpress.com/buy) for subscription comparison tables, purchasing FAQ, and licensing information.
